title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
ii.  The mirror agrees with me, mostly. It is the mostly I keep.
iii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iv.  What I miss most is a place I am not certain ever stood.
v.  I have a memory of the sea I cannot have earned.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
